<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Virex Hub | Social media marketing for brands</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@500;700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#120037;--bg2:#1B0950;--card:#220F5C;--line:#3A2287;--ink:#F3EEFF;--muted:#BBAFE2;
  --v:#A374FF;--v2:#C9B0FF;--wa:#25D366;--sun:#FFD84D;--pink:#FF7AB8;--dark:#120037;
  box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
  color-scheme:dark;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1.05rem/1.65 "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque","Arial Black",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.05;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.25rem}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.1rem 0}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;font:800 1.4rem "Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.logo img{height:38px;width:auto;display:block;transition:transform .4s}
.logo:hover img{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.1)}
nav{display:flex;gap:1.4rem;align-items:center}
nav a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;background:var(--v);color:var(--dark);padding:.9rem 1.5rem;border-radius:999px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .2s,filter .2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.03);filter:brightness(1.08)}
.btn.wa{background:var(--wa);color:#06280F}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:2px solid var(--line)}
nav .btn{padding:.6rem 1.1rem;color:#06280F}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--sun);outline-offset:3px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:2.5rem;align-items:center;padding:3rem 0 4.5rem}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,7vw,5.1rem);font-weight:800}
.hero p{max-width:34rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.2rem;margin:1.4rem 0 2rem}
.cta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.8rem}
.note{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1.4rem}
.feed{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:.6rem;transform:rotate(-3deg)}
.tile{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:.6rem;font:700 .95rem "Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--dark)}
.t1{background:var(--sun)}.t2{background:var(--pink)}.t3{background:var(--v)}
.t4{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--v);color:var(--ink)}
.t5{background:var(--bg2);border:2px solid var(--line);align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:.8rem}
.t5 img{width:78%;height:auto}
.t6{background:var(--v2)}.t7{background:var(--sun)}.t8{background:var(--pink)}
.t9{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--v);color:var(--ink)}
.t6.live{animation:pop .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) backwards,bob 5s ease-in-out .8s infinite,ping 2s ease-out 1s infinite}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.6) rotate(-8deg)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
@keyframes ping{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(163,116,255,.8)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 20px rgba(163,116,255,0)}}
@keyframes slide{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@keyframes wap{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,.7)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 22px rgba(37,211,102,0)}}
.hero h1{animation:rise .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) .1s backwards}
.hero p{animation:rise .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) .3s backwards}
.hero .cta-row{animation:rise .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) .5s backwards}
.tile{animation:pop .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) backwards,bob 5s ease-in-out .8s infinite}
.tile:hover{transform:scale(1.08) rotate(2deg);animation-play-state:paused,paused;transition:transform .2s}
.marq{overflow:hidden;border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);padding:1rem 0}
.track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:slide 28s linear infinite;font:800 1.6rem "Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.marq:hover .track{animation-play-state:paused}
.track span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2.5rem;padding-right:2.5rem;white-space:nowrap}
.track span::after{content:"";width:.45em;height:.45em;border-radius:50%;background:var(--v)}
section{padding:4.5rem 0}
section h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.6vw,3.2rem);font-weight:800;max-width:38rem}
.sub{color:var(--muted);max-width:36rem;margin:1rem 0 2.5rem}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:1.25rem}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:1.6rem}
.card h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.card:nth-child(1){border-top:6px solid var(--v)}.card:nth-child(2){border-top:6px solid var(--pink)}
.card:nth-child(3){border-top:6px solid var(--sun)}.card:nth-child(4){border-top:6px solid var(--v2)}
.alt{background:var(--bg2);border-block:1px solid var(--line)}
.why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3rem;align-items:start}
.why ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:1.4rem}
.why li{padding-left:2.2rem;position:relative}
.why li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.35rem;width:1.1rem;height:1.1rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--v)}
.why li strong{display:block;font:700 1.2rem "Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,sans-serif;margin-bottom:.2rem}
.why li span{color:var(--muted)}
.steps{display:grid;gap:1.5rem;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));counter-reset:s}
.step{counter-increment:s;padding-top:1rem;border-top:3px solid var(--line);transition:border-color .25s}
.step:hover{border-color:var(--v)}
.step::before{content:counter(s);font:800 2.4rem "Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--v)}
.step h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin:.3rem 0 .4rem}.step p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.cta{background:var(--v);color:var(--dark);border-radius:30px;padding:3.2rem 2rem}
.cta h2{max-width:34rem}
.cta p{margin:1rem 0 1.8rem;max-width:32rem;font-size:1.15rem}
.cta .btn.mail{background:var(--dark);color:var(--ink)}
.cta .btn.wa{color:#06280F}
footer{padding:2.5rem 0 5rem;color:var(--muted);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;font-size:.95rem}
footer a{text-decoration:none}footer a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.float-wa{position:fixed;right:1rem;bottom:calc(1rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:20;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wa);display:grid;place-items:center;animation:wap 2.2s ease-out 2s infinite;transition:transform .2s}
.float-wa:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
.float-wa svg{width:30px;height:30px;fill:#06280F}
.js .rv{opacity:0;translate:0 28px;transition:opacity .7s ease,translate .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.js .rv.in{opacity:1;translate:0 0}
.js .card.rv{transition:opacity .7s ease,translate .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-.6deg);box-shadow:0 18px 32px -16px rgba(163,116,255,.55)}
@media (max-width:820px){.hero,.why{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding-top:1.5rem}.feed{transform:none}nav a:not(.btn){display:none}.why{gap:2rem}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}html{scroll-behavior:auto}.js .rv{opacity:1;translate:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
<header>
  <a class="logo" href="#top"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">Virex Hub</a>
  <nav><a href="#brands">Who we help</a><a href="#services">Services</a><a href="#process">How it works</a><a class="btn wa" href="https://wa.me/8801785227787?text=Hi%20Virex%20Hub%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20grow%20my%20brand." target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp us</a></nav>
</header>

<main id="top">
<div class="hero">
  <div>
    <h1>Get more orders from social media.</h1>
    <p>Virex Hub helps clothing brands and local online brands get noticed, earn trust and turn followers into paying customers, with ads, posts, graphic design and full social media management.</p>
    <div class="cta-row">
      <a class="btn wa" href="https://wa.me/8801785227787?text=Hi%20Virex%20Hub%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20grow%20my%20brand." target="_blank" rel="noopener">Message us on WhatsApp</a>
      <a class="btn ghost" href="#services">See what we do</a>
    </div>
    <p class="note">Built for brands that sell on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="feed" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="tile t1">New drop</div><div class="tile t2">Stories</div><div class="tile t3">Order now</div>
    <div class="tile t4">Ads</div><div class="tile t5"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""></div><div class="tile t6 live">Sold out!</div>
    <div class="tile t7">Reels</div><div class="tile t8">Reviews</div><div class="tile t9">DMs</div>
  </div>
</div>
</main>
</div>

<div class="marq" aria-hidden="true"><div class="track"><span>Run ads</span><span>Create posts</span><span>Graphic design</span><span>Social media management</span><span>Clothing brands</span><span>Local online brands</span><span>Run ads</span><span>Create posts</span><span>Graphic design</span><span>Social media management</span><span>Clothing brands</span><span>Local online brands</span></div></div>

<div class="wrap">
<section id="brands">
  <h2>Made for brands that sell online.</h2>
  <p class="sub">Your customers are scrolling right now. We make sure they see your brand, trust it and message you to buy.</p>
  <div class="grid">
    <div class="card"><h3>Clothing brands</h3><p>Show off every drop with photos, reels and ads that stop the scroll and send buyers straight to your page.</p></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Local online brands</h3><p>Reach people in your area who are ready to buy, and turn their messages into real orders.</p></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Individuals</h3><p>Creator, freelancer or building a personal brand? We help you look professional and grow your audience too.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>
</div>

<div class="alt"><div class="wrap">
<section id="services">
  <h2>Four ways we grow your brand.</h2>
  <p class="sub">Pick one service, or hand us your whole social media and focus on running your business.</p>
  <div class="grid">
    <div class="card"><h3>Run ads</h3><p>Facebook, Instagram and TikTok ads aimed at the right people, built to bring you messages and orders.</p></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Create posts</h3><p>Photos, short videos and captions that sound like your brand and give people a reason to follow and buy.</p></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Graphic design</h3><p>Posts, banners, offers and brand visuals that look clean and professional, so customers trust you at first sight.</p></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Social media management</h3><p>We plan, post and reply to comments and messages every week, so your pages stay active and no customer is left waiting.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>
</div></div>

<div class="wrap">
<section>
  <div class="why">
    <h2>Posting is not enough. Your brand needs a plan.</h2>
    <ul>
      <li class="rv"><strong>Content made to sell</strong><span>Every post and design has a job: get attention, build trust or bring an order.</span></li>
      <li class="rv"><strong>Ads with a clear goal</strong><span>We set each campaign up for one result, such as more messages, more visits or more sales.</span></li>
      <li class="rv"><strong>One team for everything</strong><span>Design, posting and ads work together, so your brand looks and sounds the same everywhere.</span></li>
      <li class="rv"><strong>Quick replies on WhatsApp</strong><span>Talk to us directly, share your ideas and get answers without long waits.</span></li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="process" style="padding-top:1rem">
  <h2>Getting started is simple.</h2>
  <p class="sub">Four steps from first message to a brand that keeps growing.</p>
  <div class="steps">
    <div class="step"><h3>Say hello</h3><p>Message us on WhatsApp and tell us about your brand.</p></div>
    <div class="step"><h3>Get a plan</h3><p>We suggest the content and ads that fit your goals and budget.</p></div>
    <div class="step"><h3>We create and launch</h3><p>We design, post and run your ads.</p></div>
    <div class="step"><h3>Improve and grow</h3><p>We check what works and do more of it.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="contact" style="padding-top:2rem">
  <div class="cta">
    <h2>Ready to get more orders from social media?</h2>
    <p>Tell us about your brand and what you want to achieve. We will get back to you quickly.</p>
    <div class="cta-row">
      <a class="btn wa" href="https://wa.me/8801785227787?text=Hi%20Virex%20Hub%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20grow%20my%20brand." target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp +880 1785 227787</a>
      <a class="btn mail" href="mailto:hubvirex@gmail.com">hubvirex@gmail.com</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <a class="logo" href="#top" style="font-size:1.15rem"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" style="height:30px">Virex Hub</a>
  <span>Social media marketing for brands</span>
  <span>© 2026 Virex Hub</span>
</footer>
</div>

<a class="float-wa" href="https://wa.me/8801785227787?text=Hi%20Virex%20Hub%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20grow%20my%20brand." target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Chat with Virex Hub on WhatsApp"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3C7 3 3 6.8 3 11.5c0 1.9.7 3.7 1.900 5.100L4 21l4.600-1.300c1 .4 2.200.6 3.400.6 5 0 9-3.800 9-8.500S17 3 12 3z"/></svg></a>

<script>
(function(){
var d=document,r=d.documentElement;
r.classList.add('js');
d.querySelectorAll('.tile').forEach(function(t,i){if(!t.classList.contains('live')){t.style.animationDelay=(i*.07)+'s,'+(.8+i*.3)+'s';}});
var els=d.querySelectorAll('section h2,.sub,.card,.step,.cta,.why li');
els.forEach(function(e){e.classList.add('rv');});
if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){els.forEach(function(e){e.classList.add('in');});return;}
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(list){
  list.forEach(function(x){
    if(!x.isIntersecting){return;}
    var e=x.target,i=Array.prototype.indexOf.call(e.parentNode.children,e);
    setTimeout(function(){e.classList.add('in');},i*90);
    io.unobserve(e);
  });
},{threshold:.15});
els.forEach(function(e){io.observe(e);});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
